title: De-extinction
description: Bring a genome back into a living body and it must be fed for its size: an animal's upkeep grows not with its mass but with its mass to the three-quarters, so a mammoth burns less per kilo than a mouse. Grow it at its own body temperature, in the air it once breathed. Unlocks the Revival Vat.

puzzle.goal: Across animals from shrews to whales, the resting metabolic rate grows with body mass M not in proportion but as M to the three-quarters (Kleiber's law). Write P, the resting power, with B₀ the constant of proportion.
puzzle.name: Kleiber's law
puzzle.ask: Find P in watts for a mammoth: B₀ = @{A} W/kg^(3/4), M = @{M} kg.
puzzle.method: Fit log P against log M across mammals: the slope is three-quarters, the networks that feed the body branching as fractals.
